issues.legal_issue: A gift of business or professional property qualifies for the gift-tax exemption only when the donor establishes that it was made in the course of carrying on the activity and bona fide for its purpose.
material_facts: The donor was a medical practitioner and gifted his son adjoining land and a hospital building used in his medical practice.
The deed described the gift as made out of love and affection.
The son had qualified in medicine shortly before the gift and joined the donor's profession several months afterward.
No evidence before the taxing authorities established that the gift was made in the course of the donor's profession or bona fide for its purpose.
issues.conclusion: The gift of the hospital building and adjoining land was not exempt from gift tax under section 5(1)(xiv), and the appeal was allowed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(1)(xiv) of the Gift-tax Act, 1958 exempts a gift made in the course of carrying on a business, profession or vocation only to the extent the donor proves to the satisfaction of the Gift-tax Officer that it was made bona fide for the purpose of that activity. The provision does not exempt a gift merely because the donor carries on a profession or because the property was used for the same purpose before and after the gift. The Court did not decide whether commercial expediency is an appropriate test. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: gift_tax_exemption_claim and donor_carries_on_profession and (not evidence_gift_in_course_of_profession or not evidence_gift_for_professional_purpose)

predicates.gift_tax_exemption_claim: The donor claims that a gift is exempt from gift tax because it relates to a business, profession or vocation.
predicates.donor_carries_on_profession: The donor carries on a profession.
predicates.evidence_gift_in_course_of_profession: Evidence establishes that the gift was made in the course of carrying on the donor's profession.
predicates.evidence_gift_for_professional_purpose: Evidence establishes that the gift was made bona fide for the purpose of the donor's profession.
predicates.gift_tax_exemption_denied: The gift is not exempt from gift tax on the claimed professional-purpose ground.

issues.definition: When a donor who carries on a profession claims this exemption, the gift is not exempt if evidence fails to establish either that it was made in the course of the profession or that it was made bona fide for its purpose.
